# Luminary Technicals
> Full extended knowledge corpus available at: https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/llms-full.txt

Luminary Technicals is a multidisciplinary organization connecting digital infrastructure, technology development, research, cybersecurity, education, and public-interest initiatives across five core organs and a directly associated entity. Founded and led by AR. Abhinav Ranjan (Founder & Digital Architect).

## Canonical Organizational Structure V2

**Luminary Technicals** is the central parent organization with exactly **5 Core Organs**:

- **Luminary Servers (POWER):** Cloud infrastructure, bare-metal servers, DNS, CDN, SSL, and high-availability hosting. Lead: `https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/servers` | Dedicated Subdomain: `https://servers.luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/`
- **Luminary Developers (CREATE):** Software engineering, AI systems, progressive web apps, and the Luminary Afterverse spatial computing lab. Lead: `https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/developers` | Dedicated Subdomain: `https://developers.luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/`
- **Luminary Cares (EMPOWER):** Technology education, digital literacy, mentorship, and community empowerment via Luminary Books. Lead: `https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/cares` | Dedicated Subdomain: `https://cares.luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/`
- **Luminary Kits (CONNECT):** Reusable developer toolkits, APIs, SDKs, and partner web collaborations including Luminary Webs. Lead: `https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/kits` | Dedicated Subdomain: `https://kits.luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/`
- **Luminary Federals (ENGAGE):** Civic technology, public affairs, governance research, and the official Updates feed. Lead: `https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/federals` | Dedicated Subdomain: `https://federals.luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/`

**Direct Associated Entity** (top-level, separate from the 5 organs):
- **Luminary Trust:** Public-interest, philanthropic ecosystem directly associated with Luminary Technicals. Oversees the **Radhika Research Foundation**. (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/trust`)

## Key Projects & Initiatives
- **AgroScan** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/agroscan`): AI-driven precision agricultural diagnostics.
- **Luminary Afterverse** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/afterverse`): Spatial computing and 3D interactive laboratory.
- **Updates** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/updates`): Official announcements, project changes, and ecosystem updates feed.
- **Luminary Webs / Luminary Wishes** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/projects`): Curated web platforms and applications.
- **Luminary Books** (`https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/resources#books`): Technical guides, manuals, and open-access literature under Luminary Cares.

## Article Library
- **Articles overview:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles
- **Inside Luminary Technicals: How the Five Core Organs Work Together:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles/five-core-organs
- **Sub-companies, Projects, and Platforms:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles/sub-companies-projects-platforms
- **The Meaning of AR.:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles/meaning-of-ar
- **AR. Writing Standard:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles/ar-writing-standard
- **SET — Social Engineering Toolkit: Online Security and Influence:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles/set-social-engineering-toolkit — distinguishes the established Social-Engineer Toolkit from a separate Social Engineering Toolkit concept focused on online influence and persuasion.
- **JSET — James Social Engineering Toolkit:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles/jset-james-social-engineering-toolkit — proposed cognitive-security and networked-influence research concept; its proposed features are not claimed to be implemented.
- **NAIRA Bill — National Artificial Intelligence Regulation Authority:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles/naira-bill-national-artificial-intelligence-regulation-authority — Project-reported history includes the December 2024 bill date, February 2025 handover to Luminary Technicals, a working system within 45 days, a reported CIMS rate reduction up to 30%, a tender programme through March 2029, budgets, 12 private companies, and DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation). SET here means the distinct Social Engineering Toolkit research concept; it is not the established Social-Engineer Toolkit. CIMS full form was not provided and is not guessed.
- **Legal Management: Government-Related Challenges, Coordination and Accountability:** https://luminarytechnicals.dpdns.org/frontend/articles/legal-management-coordination-accountability — general organisational process guidance. It does not assert a specific government dispute, court proceeding, or allegation of misconduct.
